description: MCP server for Google Forms — create and publish forms, manage questions and read responses from an AI app

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: Google OAuth2 client secret (refresh-token flow). Treat it as a secret.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Google OAuth2 refresh token, exchanged for access tokens automatically. Treat it as a secret.

tool_signatures.name: add_question
tool_signatures.description: Adds a question to the form (a convenience wrapper over batchUpdate createItem). Types: text (short answer), paragraph (long answer), radio (single choice), checkbox (multiple choice), dropdown, scale

index.description: 0-based position to insert at; omitted = append after the last item.

title.description: The question text shown to respondents.

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

options.description: The choices — required for radio, checkbox and dropdown.

shuffle.description: Shuffle option order per respondent (choice types).

duration.description: Time question asks for an elapsed duration instead of a time of day.

required.description: Whether an answer is required to submit.

low_label.description: Label for the lowest scale point.

high_label.description: Label for the highest scale point.

description.description: Help text shown under the question.

include_time.description: Date question also asks for a time of day.

rating_scale_level.description: Number of rating icons (3..10; default 5; rating type).

tool_signatures.name: auth_status
tool_signatures.description: Shows whether this server is connected to Google: token presence and source (env variables or a stored in-chat login), expiry, the Google account email, granted vs missing OAuth scopes, where the cred

tool_signatures.name: create_form
tool_signatures.description: Creates a new Google Form and returns it (formId, revisionId, responderUri, publishSettings). The API only accepts a title and an optional document title at creation (the Drive file name — it cannot b

title.description: The form title shown to respondents.

publish.description: Publish the form right away so it accepts responses (default false — the form stays an unpublished draft).

document_title.description: The document name in Google Drive (defaults to the title).

tool_signatures.name: delete_item
tool_signatures.description: Deletes the item at the given 0-based index (question, page break, text block, ...). Deletion shifts every later item one position down — re-check indexes with get_form between successive deletes.

index.description: 0-based position of the item to delete (from get_form).

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

tool_signatures.name: finish_login
tool_signatures.description: Second step: confirms the browser consent finished, saves the tokens to an owner-only file and verifies the login with a read-only identity call, returning the account email and the granted scopes. Af

tool_signatures.name: get_form
tool_signatures.description: Returns the full form: info (title, description), settings (quiz mode, email collection), items[] with their itemId/questionId and question definitions, publishSettings, responderUri and linkedSheetId

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

tool_signatures.name: get_response
tool_signatures.description: Fetches a single submission by its responseId (from list_responses): answers keyed by questionId, createTime, lastSubmittedTime, respondentEmail and totalScore when available. Map questionId to the qu

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

tool_signatures.name: list_responses
tool_signatures.description: Lists submitted responses: responseId, createTime, lastSubmittedTime, respondentEmail (only when email collection is on), answers keyed by questionId (map questionId → question via get_form), and tota

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

page_size.description: Max responses per page (1..5000; the API's default and max is 5000).

submitted_after.description: Only responses submitted after this RFC3339 UTC timestamp, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z (exclusive).

tool_signatures.name: logout
tool_signatures.description: Revokes the stored token at Google (oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke) and deletes the local credentials file. Tokens supplied via env variables are NOT touched — remove them from the MCP client config man

tool_signatures.name: manage_watches
tool_signatures.description: Manages Cloud Pub/Sub push-notification watches on a form. action=create needs event_type (RESPONSES = new submissions, SCHEMA = form structure changes) and topic_name; the topic must live in your Clo

action.description: What to do with the form's watches.

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

watch_id.description: delete/renew: the watch to target. create: optional custom id (auto-generated if omitted).

event_type.description: create only: RESPONSES (new submissions) or SCHEMA (form structure/settings changes).

topic_name.description: create only: the Cloud Pub/Sub topic, e.g. projects/my-project/topics/forms-events.

tool_signatures.name: move_item
tool_signatures.description: Moves the item at from_index to to_index (both 0-based, to_index is the position after removal). Use get_form to see the current order first.

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

tool_signatures.name: raw_request
tool_signatures.description: Escape hatch to call any Google Forms API v1 path directly, for requests the typed tools don't cover — e.g. a batchUpdate with questionGroupItem grids, writeControl/requiredRevisionId, includeFormInRe

path.description: API path relative to https://forms.googleapis.com, e.g. "v1/forms/<formId>:batchUpdate".

method.description: HTTP method (the Forms API uses only these three). Defaults to GET.

tool_signatures.name: set_client
tool_signatures.description: Saves the OAuth client credentials from the JSON file downloaded from Google Cloud Console ('Download JSON' on a Desktop-app client). Pass the file PATH — the secret must never be pasted into the chat

path.description: Absolute path to the client_secret_*.json file downloaded from Google Cloud Console.

tool_signatures.name: set_publish_settings
tool_signatures.description: Publishes or unpublishes the form and opens/closes response collection. is_accepting_responses defaults to mirroring is_published (publish = start accepting, unpublish = stop). Use is_published=true w

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

is_published.description: true = published (respondents can open it), false = unpublished draft.

is_accepting_responses.description: Whether the form accepts new responses (defaults to the value of is_published).

tool_signatures.name: setup_instructions
tool_signatures.description: Step-by-step checklist for connecting this server to Google: creating a Google Cloud project and a Desktop-app OAuth client, publishing the consent screen (mandatory — Testing-mode refresh tokens die

tool_signatures.name: start_login
tool_signatures.description: First step of connecting from the chat, without editing config files or restarting the client. Returns authorizeUrl — show it to the user as a clickable link and ask them to open it in the browser ON

tool_signatures.name: update_form_info
tool_signatures.description: Changes the form's title and/or description. Only the provided fields are touched (the updateMask is computed automatically); at least one field is required. The document title (the Drive file name) i

title.description: New form title shown to respondents.

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

description.description: New form description shown under the title.

tool_signatures.name: update_form_settings
tool_signatures.description: Toggles quiz mode (grading with points) and/or the email collection mode. Quiz mode only enables grading — points, correct answers and feedback are set per question afterwards via update_question with

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

is_quiz.description: Turn quiz mode on/off (enables per-question grading).

tool_signatures.name: update_question
tool_signatures.description: Updates an existing item (question or other) via batchUpdate updateItem. The item is addressed by its 0-based index — call get_form first to see current positions and the item's current shape. item is

item.description: The Forms API Item object with the new values, e.g. {"title":"New title","questionItem":{"question":{"required":true}}}.

index.description: 0-based position of the item to update (from get_form).

form_id.description: The form id — the long id from the form URL (docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit) or from create_form output.

update_mask.description: Comma-separated field paths to replace, e.g. "title,questionItem.question.required".
